items.title: Molecular Breeding Specialist Assistant - China Agriculture University
items.detail: Managed the post-transformation pipeline and phenotypic screening for CRISPR-edited corn and soybean lines. Bridged wet-lab operations with digital workflows by optimizing acclimatization protocols for delicate T0 plantlets, achieving an 86% survival and regeneration rate during greenhouse transitions. Conducted high-throughput data acquisition by integrating mechanical threshers and image-based automated seed analytics to digitize agronomic traits and automate inventory logging. Maintained 100% pedigree traceability and metadata integrity across progressive T0 to T2 generations. Executed genomic DNA extractions and qPCR molecular assays to support the screening and validation of homozygous, transgene-free stable lineages.
